hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git fetch --quiet origin main 2>/dev/null; echo "Current branch: $(git branch --show-current)"; echo 'Latest commits on main:'; git log --oneline -10 origin/main 2>/dev/null; echo; echo 'Latest project log (docs/log.md):'; sed -n '/^---$/,$p' docs/log.md 2>/dev/null | head -30
